context.transcript:
Do you have a big move coming up? Look no further than
Martin Movers! oWe can pack up all your belongings and
get them where they need to go in our spacious moving
trucks. Customers rave about how fast, clean, and reliable
our service is. We are proud of our ten years of experience
serving the community. OTo celebrate our tenth anniversary,
we're waiving the cost of supplies for the month of May.
That's free boxes, tape, and foam wrap for your
breakables! Schedule today to get this great deal!
context.transcript_translation: 你近期要进行一次大规模搬家吗？马丁搬家公司就是您的最佳选择！我们可以打包您的全部物品，并用宽敞的搬家卡车把它们运到目的地。顾客都对我们快速、整洁而可靠的服务赞不绝口。我们为自己服务社区长达十年的经验感到自豪。为庆祝成立十周年，五月份我们将免收包装用品费用。也就是说，易碎物品所需的纸箱、胶带和泡沫包装材料全都免费！立即预约，即可享受这项超值优惠！
